releases.name: Phux Rune 0.1.61
releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.61**: 2 changes since 0.1.60.

- Deliberate phone pulls and swipes follow the latest finger position when moves arrive together.
- Payload-free connection diagnostics identify the WebSocket establishment stage where a connection stalls.

releases.name: Phux Rune 0.1.60
releases.body:
**Phux Rune 0.1.60**: 6 changes since 0.1.59.

- Polish the mobile sessions drawer
- Make the iPhone terminal composer toggleable
- Export painted iPhone buttons for native activation
- Rework iPhone terminal input and session switching
- Developer mode and labs, feature flags every client and the server read
- Frost sessions in place and swipe between tabs before sessions (#3033)
